searxng.description: Web search via SearXNG (meta search - Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo, etc.)
searxng._note: Runs as a LOCAL subprocess (mcp-searxng, installed in the PAAW image) - no docker, no socket. Reaches the SearXNG service over the compose network at searxng:8080. The executor stops the subprocess after each job.

mcp-discord.description: Send and fetch messages from Discord channels

whatsapp.description: Send WhatsApp messages via the PAAW WhatsApp bot (Baileys). Talks to the bot's HTTP bridge - it does NOT open its own WhatsApp session.
whatsapp._note: Runs as a LOCAL subprocess (node index.js, shipped in the PAAW image) - no docker, no socket. Forwards to the always-on 'whatsapp' bridge service over the compose network at whatsapp:3000. The executor stops the subprocess after each job.

_comment: Set 'enabled: true' to activate an MCP server. PAAW will start it automatically. Use ${VAR} for environment variables.
